newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Three more join Pakistan caretaker cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Three more join Pakistan caretaker cabinet.

text.p: Three more ministers joined Pakistan's caretaker cabinet on Tuesday, taking its strength to 12, a government statement said.

The three, given the oath of office by President Farooq Leghari, were Abdul Ghaffar Jatoi (Communications), Muhammad Afzal Khan (Health, and Population Welfare with additional charge of railways), and Subedar Khan Mandokhel (Housing and Works).
Another minister, Amanullah Khan Gichki, has also been brought into the cabinet and will be sworn in later, the official APP news agency said.
Meraj Khalid took over as caretaker prime minister after Leghari sacked prime minister Benazir Bhutto on November 5 on disputed charges of corruption, nepotism and misrule.
